errors.text_span: 2021 г. с около 58 000 хил. лв., 2020 г. с приблизително 57 000 хил. лв.
errors.evidence: The values for 2020 and 2021 are both closer to 59,000 and 58,000 respectively. The provided estimates of 57,000 and 58,000 are slightly low, although the relative ranking (2021 > 2020) is correct.

errors.text_span: които се изменят от 0 до 80 000 хил. лв. с равни интервали от 10 000 хил. лв.
errors.evidence: The phrase repeats the unit "хил. лв." (thousands of levs) after the numbers, which is redundant. The y-axis label already indicates the unit is "Хиляди лева" (Thousands of levs), so stating "80,000 thousands of levs" is awkward phrasing.

errors.text_span: със стойност малко над 48 000 хил. лв.
errors.evidence: The bar for 2018 is clearly just below 50,000 (around 49,000). While technically 49,000 is "a little over 48,000", this is an unnatural and imprecise way to describe a value that is much closer to 50,000. A clearer description would be "около 49 000" (around 49,000).
